explanation: The initial laboratory values are sodium 148 mEq/L, chloride 101 mEq/L, bicarbonate 18.4 mEq/L, and albumin 5.3 g/dL. Using the standard potassium-excluding formula, anion gap = 148 − (101 + 18.4) = 28.6 mEq/L. Albumin-corrected anion gap = 28.6 + 2.5 × (4 − 5.3) = 25.35 mEq/L. No unit conversions are needed, and the result falls within the accepted range.
